name: Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy
definition: Heterogeneous group of inherited muscular dystrophies causing predominantly shoulder- and pelvic-girdle weakness with variable cardiac and respiratory involvement.

investigations.principle: CK, EMG, muscle MRI and genetic testing are subtype-directed.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Treatment and prognosis vary substantially by genetic subtype.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mamsa/Bala-kshaya phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Heterogeneous group of inherited muscular dystrophies causing predominantly shoulder- and pelvic-girdle weakness with variable cardiac and respiratory involvement.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
